feed_top.author: corvale-scanner
feed_top.text: Big line at Quillfeather Hall for the klezmer show. Doors just opened.

feed_top.author: corvale-scanner
feed_top.text: Crash at Fennick St and 11th Ave. Minor, but both lanes are blocked for now. Expect delays toward Lakeview.

feed_top.author: mika-sorensen
feed_top.text: Friday off for once. Taking my mom out for pho.

feed_top.author: corvale-transit
feed_top.text: Staff reported 214 public comments on the fare proposal, most asking for a cheaper monthly pass. The vote is set for April 10.

feed_top.author: corvale-lantern
feed_top.text: New crosswalk signals coming to Lakeview Rd and 9th Ave after two crashes

newest.text: Eastbound Green Line trains are running about 6 minutes late because of an unplanned track inspection near Ash Yard.

newest.author: green-line-ops
newest.text: Eastbound Green Line: 7-minute delays because of a signal problem at Ash Yard. Westbound trains are on time.

feed_top.author: pine-hollow-neighbors
feed_top.text: Smoke over the ridge north of Pine Hollow tonight. The county says crews are on the Cinder Fork Fire; no evacuation notices.

feed_top.author: hal-reyes
feed_top.text: Anyone else at Quillfeather? Opening act ran long, main set just started.

feed_top.author: corvale-scanner
feed_top.text: Several people are asking which direction. We have asked Corvale Regional Transit.

newest.text: Free Green Line and bus rides after 8 pm on New Year's Eve, Wednesday, Dec. 31. Please ride instead of driving.

newest.text: @green-line-ops Is the last Green Line train canceled tonight? Eastbound, westbound or both?

newest.author: june-okoro
newest.text: If you're at Quillfeather tonight, the last Green Line train is apparently canceled. Plan ahead.

feed_top.author: hal-reyes
feed_top.text: Lakeview had a bald eagle over the water.

feed_top.text: Free rides on the Green Line from 8 pm tonight until the last trains, which leave Fennick St at 1:40 am. Happy New Year from the crews.
